newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina crash kills at least 10, injures 78.
newsitem.headline: Argentina crash kills at least 10, injures 78.

text.p: At least 10 people were killed and 78 injured on Friday when four buses and a car crashed in dense fog and caught fire on a busy highway, local news agencies reported.
The vehicles collided in Zarate, 56 miles (90 km) north of Buenos Aires, on what is commonly described as the "death road" because of the large number of accidents there.
The car was crushed by one of the buses and both vehicles caught fire, the local DyN and Telam news agencies reported. The other buses then crashed into them.
